description: This Dart file defines a Flutter widget 'TransactionsScreen' that displays a list of recent transactions. It manages loading transactions, caching category metadata, and presenting the data with UI components including a sliver-based scroll view with loading and empty states.

classes.name: TransactionsScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that displays recent transactions, handling loading states and navigation to add or edit transactions.

classes.name: _TransactionsScreenState
classes.description: State class managing the transactions list, loading state, category metadata cache, and building the UI.

methods.name: didChangeDependencies
methods.description: Loads recent transactions once when dependencies change, initiating data fetch.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the UI scaffold, including a CustomScrollView with a SliverAppBar, loading indicator, empty state, and a list of transactions with asynchronously fetched category info.
